items.area: start order vs L13-31 (ruling recorded after the brief)
items.evidence: cutoverReadiness.order puts 'Acquire documentation write lease; freeze starts' (step 4) before 'Final main import with accounting; record F' (step 5). ownerDecision.condition.requiredBefore points at the lease step. G1 and the field name atFinalPinUnderLease imply the F duties run under the lease. L13-31 says something different: the active release 2bef8cb2 has no docs-lease verb; the freeze starts at the F import by board convention (lead:LAND posts the notice first); F is imported only after HARDEN answers; and the real lease comes after G11 release R and G10 rehearsal, which is consistent with the register's own G10/G11 duties (release R from F code, rehearsal before lease). The register and verify.py (which hard-codes this order) contradict L13-31. This is not a defect of 45da92781, since L13-31 postdates the brief, but the register is stale on the start condition.
